sentences: I record daily sales transactions into the general journal and update the subsidiary ledgers.
I reconcile the bank statement with our cash ledger each month to ensure accuracy.
I calculate depreciation for fixed assets using the straight-line method and record the expense.
I prepare the trial balance to ensure debits equal credits before making adjustments.
I process vendor invoices and schedule payments in accounts payable according to terms.
I review accounts receivable aging to identify overdue customer balances and follow up.
I file quarterly payroll taxes and submit the required forms to federal and state agencies.
I post adjusting entries for accrued expenses at period end to match revenues.
I analyze budget variances by comparing actual to planned figures and noting significant deviations.
I prepare the income statement and balance sheet for management review each quarter.
I track inventory costs using the weighted average method and update the inventory ledger.
I recognize revenue when performance obligations are met and record the corresponding receivable.
I amortize prepaid insurance premiums over the policy period and adjust the expense account.
I conduct an internal audit of expense reports for compliance with company policies.
I manage cash flow projections to ensure sufficient liquidity for upcoming operational needs.
I close the books at month-end by zeroing out temporary accounts and transferring balances.
I calculate the debt-to-equity ratio from financial statements to assess capital structure.
I maintain the fixed asset register and update depreciation schedules for all capitalized items.
I prepare the statement of cash flows using the indirect method and reconcile net income.
I reconcile intercompany transactions to eliminate discrepancies and ensure consolidated statements are accurate.
